newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Stray bullet hits near Rio mayor's office.
newsitem.headline: Stray bullet hits near Rio mayor's office.

text.p: A stray bullet landed on the lawn outside the office of Rio de Janeiro Mayor Cesar Maia on Thursday but no injuries were reported, a city spokesman said.

Stray bullet reports, in which innocent bystanders were killed or wounded, have been frequent in Rio recently. The bullets are blamed on the growing drug trade in shantytowns and the high-calibre weapons used by drug traffickers.
